notes: Takes LiveDevelop.swift and one line of DevelopInspector.swift from develop (crop after tone; CropInspector gets menu.photo.crop), two lines of loupe-viewport's LibraryLoupeImage.swift (the loupe renders the whole straightened photo while cropping; a focus change closes the draft) and the overlay and artboard lines of LibraryLoupe.swift. CR-e may close with gaps if core's detector hasn't shipped.
library_title: Crop and straighten in the loupe, applied in render, thumbnail and export

slices.behavior: On the fakes, R opens a crop draft on the loupe photo, chips, drags and a typed angle reshape it, Return stores it as one "Crop" step, and Cancel, drags and leaving the photo record nothing.
On real pixels the frame stays inside the straightened photo, and the loupe, thumbnails and export get the turned and cropped picture.
In the loupe, Photo > Crop shows the frame with handles, the aspect chips, Straighten, Auto, Apply and Cancel, all reachable from the keyboard.
On real files the 1:1 frame straightened 5 degrees is 3545 px and survives a relaunch, and a corner drag stays within its frame budget.
Auto levels a tilted horizon on a real photo.
